svg.desc: Forward and backward stages of a remote expert route over InfiniBand and NVLink.

g.text: 0–2: MLA + dense FFN · 3–60: MLA + one shared expert and 8 of 256 routed experts
Loss gradient → head → blocks 60 to 0 → embedding. Parameter gradients feed the optimizer.
InfiniBand connects the nodes. The remote gateway relays the activation over NVLink, and the expert output returns along the same route.
A token chunk = a bundle of routed rows (the scheduler's “tile”)
One row = one routed token activation
Transfer and schedule this row bundle together.
Its ID follows activations, outputs and input gradients.
Example size: 128 BF16 rows = 1.75 MiB per activation hop.
Chunk count is separate from the full sequence length.
M: token rows · N: output channels
M / N / K tile sizes are selected
Send activation to the expert node
Source GPU → remote gateway · token activation
Gateway → expert GPU · activation chunk ready
Token activation × gate and up weights
Expert GPU → gateway · expert output chunk
Gateway → source node · ready for weighted sum

g.text: First overlap · InfiniBand carries chunk 3, NVLink relays chunk 2, and compute uses chunk 1.
Bar numbers identify token chunks. Follow the same number down the rows as its activations, outputs and gradients move.
Unit ticks show dependencies. Isolated B300 probes available: none. Pending: expert compute, InfiniBand, NVLink.
